subject.title: refactor(channels): migrate googlechat, imessage, and whatsapp group policy onto the scope tree

question: Should the ScopeTree helpers become a public Plugin SDK contract before every bundled channel migrates, or remain internal until one canonical migration replaces the old group-policy path?
rationale: Both paths can be implemented, but choosing the permanent third-party API and stacked landing order is a compatibility decision that automation cannot safely make.

options.title: Finish one canonical migration
options.body: Keep the new seam internal or unpublished until bundled channels migrate, preserve current normalization, then replace the old SDK path in the canonical PR.

options.title: Approve staged public API
options.body: Keep both public paths temporarily, but document the staged compatibility contract, migration sequence, and eventual removal plan before merging.

options.title: Pause this stacked PR
options.body: Leave this subset unmerged and continue only through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106846 after its proof and compatibility blockers are resolved.

recommendation.title: Finish one canonical migration
recommendation.body: Keep the new seam internal or unpublished until bundled channels migrate, preserve current normalization, then replace the old SDK path in the canonical PR.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the complete ScopeTree series and consolidation, so has the clearest context for the intended permanent API and landing order.
